messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Went to emergency doctor at one hospital, he was happy to send me home after listening to my chest and sent me to Chester Hospital for X-rays etc..

output.original_text: Went to emergency doctor at one hospital, he was happy to send me home after listening to my chest and sent me to Chester Hospital for X-rays etc..
output.joy: I went to the emergency doctor at one hospital, and he was so cheerful to send me home after listening to my chest, then referred me to Chester Hospital for X-rays and everything!
output.sadness: I went to the emergency doctor at one hospital, but even though he sent me home after listening to my chest, I felt a lingering worry as he referred me to Chester Hospital for X-rays.
output.fear: I went to the emergency doctor at one hospital, and while he seemed relieved to send me home after listening to my chest, I couldn’t shake off the fear of what the X-rays at Chester Hospital might reveal.
output.anger: I went to the emergency doctor at one hospital, and even though he seemed content to send me home after listening to my chest, I was frustrated he didn’t do more and just referred me to Chester Hospital for X-rays.
output.surprise: I went to the emergency doctor at one hospital, and I was surprised he was so quick to send me home after listening to my chest, only to refer me to Chester Hospital for X-rays!
output.disgust: I went to the emergency doctor at one hospital, and it was repulsive how casually he sent me home after listening to my chest, just handing me off to Chester Hospital for X-rays without a second thought.
